## Review checklist
- [ ] Existing history and original scientific outputs preserved
- [ ] Full diff and newly indexed figures reviewed
- [ ] Data/sample provenance limitations retained
- [ ] Result evidence and validation gates checked
- [ ] No raw reads, assemblies, databases, complete logs or executables
- [ ] No credentials, private identifiers or unreviewed sensitive information
- [ ] File-size, staged safety and local-link checks passed
- [ ] Methods/versions/resources and status updated
- [ ] No unsupported missing-DNA/misassembly claims
- [ ] Push/merge approved by repository owner
